d:
A reported property deal involving Rajasthan IAS officer Shikhar Agarwal, his wife IPS officer Prashakha Mathur, and their family has raised questions about property disclosures and transparency.
According to a Dainik Bhaskar investigation, the family reportedly purchased 40 villas and cottages at Ananta Resorts in Udaipur, Rajasthan, for a combined registered value of approximately ₹6.15 crore. The report also claims that these properties were leased back to a business associated with the seller, with an annual rental amount of ₹1.80 crore.
